content.text: Oe BAWIPA, Devit hai thoseh,
a khang e rektapnae hai thoseh,
BAWIPA koe bangtelane thoe a kâbo tie hai thoseh,
Jakop miphun e athakaawme Bawipa koe
bangtelamaw lawk a kam tie hai thoseh, pouk haw.
Ahni ni BAWIPA onae,
Jakop miphun e Athakasaipounge a onae hmuen
ka hmu hoehroukrak,
kama im ka ban mahoeh,
ka ikhun dawk ka luen mahoeh,
ka ip mahoeh, ka mit ka pakhap mahoeh
telah lawk a kam.
Khenhaw! Ephrath vah, ka thai a teh,
ratu thung vah ka hmu awh.
Ama onae koe cet awh sei .
Ama khok toungnae hmalah tabawk awh sei .
Oe BAWIPA nama e thaonae thingkong hoi cungtalah,
nama e roumnae koe luen haw.
Nange vaihmanaw teh lannae hah khohnat awh naseh.
Nange tami kathoungnaw ni hai lunghawicalah la sak awh naseh.
Na san Devit minhmai khet lahoi satui na awi e hah
pahnawt hanh loe.
BAWIPA ni Devit koe thoe a bo teh
bout raphoe hoeh hane lawk teh:
na catoun hah na bawitungkhung dawk ka tahung sak han.
Na capanaw ni kaie lawkkam hoi
kaie lawkpanuesaknae hah tarawi awh pawiteh,
ahnimae capanaw hai nange bawitungkhung dawk
pou a tahung awh han tie hah doeh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, BAWIPA ni Zion hah a rawi teh,
hawvah o nahane hmuen lah ta hane a ngai dawkvah,
hote hmuen teh a yungyoe kaie roumnae hmuen lah ao.
Hote hmuen hah ka ngai dawkvah, hawvah ka o han.
Hote hmuen koe rawca yawhawi ka poe han.
Hote hmuen koe mathoenaw hai rawca ka boum sak han.
Hote hmuen koe e vaihmanaw heh
rungngangnae hoi ka ramuk vaiteh,
tami kathoungnaw ni lunghawi laihoi la a sak awh han.
Hawvah, Devit e ki hah ka cawn sak han.
Satui ka awi e tami hanelah,
hmaiim sut ka hruek pouh.
Kai ni ahnie tarannaw hah
kayayeirai hoi ka ramuk pouh han.
Ahni koe teh, amae lentoenae lukhung
kamhlawng sak han telah a ti.
